limitations: Only the fixed dense 4x4x4 GEMM profile is functionally qualified; no general sparse/Sparseloop claim.
Built-in Timeloop/PAT analytical energy estimates are not target-hardware measurements or calibrated Accelergy ERT. Area is not qualified.
Local Timeloop source builds were attempted but did not finish under shared-memory limits; official prebuilt provenance is explicit, build_claim=false.
The official model XML output omits its final boost_serialization root closing tag; the check preserves it verbatim and records a root-tag-only normalized copy before full-precision comparison.
Search budget is exactly six legal mappings, one thread, deterministic exhaustive enumeration with no random seed.
